players.product: plasma etch tools for 3D NAND and advanced logic (CCP incl. 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch; cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch) plus tungsten CVD / ALD deposition for 3D NAND word lines

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Yin Zhiyao (Q1 2026 results briefing), asked about overseas expansion: the company has a coordinated strategy for overseas sales, has established cooperation with several overseas IC manufacturers (not named) and made further breakthroughs overseas through a mix of direct and indirect sales; at present its revenue comes mainly from domestic customers and the overseas share of revenue is low.
